question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Gatherings**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The term "**family gatherings**" implies a broader term for family events, bringing together relatives for various celebrations or get-togethers. (विभिन्न समारोहों या मिलन समारोहों के लिए रिश्तेदारों को एक साथ लाना) • Using "**gatherings**" in this sentence helps to specify the type of family events they host and provides a more inclusive term that encompasses a range of occasions, from celebrations to reunions. • Therefore, "gatherings" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 3. Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer. (औपचारिक और संगठित सभा) • **Crowds **imply a large group of people, often in a disorderly or chaotic manner.
